decision.title: Lowering parts and the embedding entry (packet )
decision.summary: The sxml_xpath_lowerer opens the lowering machine: procedures are descriptors, lowering parts register by glob and may replace core kinds per language, and an embedding entry lowers one XPath AST into the current function.

body.p: , completing and for Phases 3 and 4. src/xpath_lower_internal.h (module xpath_lower) opens the lowering machine to other files.

item.p: The lowerer (sxml_xpath_lowerer, lifecycle quintet): one lowering into one unit, over a static context, for one sxml_language (), with a part view (empty: the registry). Building blocks are exported under sxml_xpath_lowerer_*: scratch memory, add an expression or a slot, bind in a block, finish a block, constants, raise, push and pop variables, read the focus, resolve and coerce types, signatures, enter and leave an IR function.

Procedures are descriptors: a frame holds a pointer to a static sxml_xpath_lowering_procedure (name, step function, locals size); the core's 24 procedures are a table of them, so core and part frames run alike. Steps ask for parts with sxml_xpath_lowering_call_* and return; no step runs a machine (). _push_procedure pushes any procedure with initial locals (copied bytes; one depth level), for constructs that are not AST kinds (XSLT instructions over the AST); sxml_xpath_lowerer_run_procedure runs one from outside.

Lowering parts by glob: a file src/<name>_lower.c or src/<name>_lower_<part>.c defining const sxml_xpath_lowering_part sxml_xpath_lowering_part_<part> = (languages, rules of AST kind to a procedure or a leaf function) is registered by sxml_generate_lowering_part_registry in cmake/SxmlParts.cmake (generated lowering_parts.c, sxml_xpath_lowering_registered_parts(), sorted by file). call_expression takes the first part serving the lowerer's language that lists the kind, then the core; so a part may replace a core kind for its language (XQuery FLWOR). A unit test checks that no two registered parts list one kind for a common language. The CMake function and its two lines in the root CMakeLists.txt join packet 's files after is committed (2.1 adds them then).

Embedding entry: sxml_xpath_lowering_call_embedded (from a step) and sxml_xpath_lowerer_lower_embedded (outside) lower one XPath AST into the current function: variables the caller pushed are in scope as their atoms, the focus is the caller's choice (absent, slots, fixed) or the current one, the static context is the AST's (namespaces, function table with XSLT's in-scope functions; same heap and allocator; its variable declarations are the unit's globals in order). The lowerer's AST, static context and focus are restored afterwards. sxml_xpath_lower lowers its main function through it, so the slice dumps cover it.

After a failure a lowerer is fit only for finalize. sxml_xpath_lower and _compile (xpath_static_internal.h) are unchanged: XPath, the registered parts; XQuery and XSLT compile with a lowerer of their own.
Rejected: parts as a second enum range in the core's switch (every part would edit the core); running a nested machine for embedded expressions (C recursion through a step).
